textbookBox.concept: Does a square have only one line of symmetry? Take a square piece of paper and fold it to find out. Fold it in half vertically, then horizontally, and open it out: those are two lines of symmetry.

beats.en: Does a square have only one line of symmetry? Take a square piece of paper and fold it to find out. Fold it in half vertically, then horizontally, and open it out: those are two lines of symmetry.
beats.speakEn: Does a square have only one line of symmetry? Take a square piece of paper and fold it to find out. Fold it in half vertically, then horizontally, and open it out: those are two lines of symmetry.

beats.en: When we fold along a line of symmetry, we can also say that each side of the figure is reflected by the line onto the other side. Label the corners of a square A, B, C, D.
